finalNarrowProductReview.findings: Workspace changes invalidate former callbacks. Focus changes increment the intent revision before history suppression. Deferred create/input/send check current owner, revision and focused target; legitimate own pushes recapture the committed revision. Finally cleanup cannot restore suppression into a newer intent. Retained deep-link listeners require an active subscription and current owner. Strict service matching excludes unavailable addresses.
